powerGrid.note: The archived Man-Ape page (real name M'Baku) draws all six bars at the minimum 1, in 2013 and 2018 snapshots alike. Unrated pages such as Batroc, Ulik and Moonstar show the same all-1 placeholder, so this is treated as no grid.

powerOrigins.detail: Hunted a sacred white gorilla, then bathed in its blood and ate its flesh; the ritual mystically passed the beast's strength to him.

abilities.name: Superhuman strength
abilities.detail: The White Gorilla ritual lets him lift about 10 tons.

abilities.name: Superhuman stamina
abilities.detail: His muscles tire slowly; he can fight at full effort for up to a day before fatigue sets in.

abilities.name: Superhuman agility
abilities.detail: Balance and coordination well past the limits of the finest human athletes.

abilities.name: Superhuman durability
abilities.detail: Tougher than a normal human: he can take repeated blows from super-strong foes or a fall of several storeys with little harm, though he is not invulnerable.

abilities.name: Skilled warrior
abilities.detail: Once rated Wakanda's greatest warrior after T'Challa; a seasoned hand-to-hand fighter with a gorilla-like style.

abilities.name: Arcane energy (former)
abilities.detail: After Baron Macabre raised him from the dead he could fire arcane energy blasts that grew stronger with use, until Macabre stripped the power away.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Black Panther: Long Live The King Vol 1 4

feats.text: Drugged the visiting Avengers, then fought Black Panther across Wakanda to the atomic fire pits and knocked him out while being pulled to safety.
Followed T'Challa to New York, kidnapped Monica Lynne and used her to lure the Black Panther into captivity, until Captain America beat him.
Raised from the dead with arcane power, he took the combined efforts of Black Panther, Kantu and Shuri to bring down.
feats.where: Black Panther: Long Live The King Vol 1 #4 (March 2018)

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Black Panther: Long Live The King Vol 1 4

feats.text: Challenged T'Challa for the throne at Warrior Falls and nearly crushed him in a bear hug before T'Challa broke free and made him yield.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Panther (film)

feats.text: Led the Jabari into the Battle of Mount Bashenga just as the Dora Milaje were about to fall, turning the fight against Killmonger's forces.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Panther (film)

feats.text: Fought the Talokanil aboard the Sea Leopard, taking many of them down with his new vibranium club.
